caption:
Under 20% down? You pay PMI: private mortgage insurance. It protects the lender, not you.

Example: $300K house, 10% down → $270K loan. At ~0.6%/yr, PMI ≈ $135/mo. Your rate depends on credit score and down payment.

When it goes away (conventional loans): you can request cancellation at 80% loan-to-value based on the original value, and it ends automatically at 78%. FHA mortgage insurance works differently.

PMI isn't always bad. It can get you in the door years sooner. Just know the cost.

Example numbers for illustration; talk to your lender.
